shortDescription: Create, Modify and Delete Cisco FMC network objects

options.name: auto_deploy
options.description: Option to deploy configurations to deployable devices after changes

options.name: description
options.description: The description/comment of the cisco_fmc object.

options.name: fmc
options.description: IP address or FQDN of Cisco FMC.

options.name: name
options.description: The name of the cisco_fmc object to be created, modified or deleted.

options.name: network_type
options.description: The network object type. Allowed choices are Host, Network, Range, and FQDN Use 'Host' to create, modify or delete an IP Host object Use 'Range' to create, modify or delete an IP Address Range object Use 'Network' to create, modify or delete a Network Address cisco_fmc object Use 'FQDN' to create, modify or delete an FQDN Host object

options.name: state
options.description: Whether to create/modify (C(present)), or remove (C(absent)) an object.

options.name: username
options.description: Cisco FMC Username User should have sufficient permissions to modify objects

options.name: value
options.description: FMC network object value. For network type 'Host', accepted value is a valid IPv4 address (1.1.1.1) For network type 'Range',  accepted value is a valid IPv4 address range (1.1.1.1-1.1.1.255) For network type 'Network',  accepted value is valid IPv4 network address (1.1.1.0/24) For network type 'FQDN', accepted value is a valid FQDN (www.example.com, sub.example.com, sub.sub.example.com) FTD does NOT accept wildcards
